acceptanceCriteria: A read-only static test-validity mode projects the hygiene axis from source for Playwright and RSpec files without a retained run.
Execution and strength axes stay NOT_OBSERVED in static mode; the mode writes nothing.
Spec requirements and tests cover skipped, focused, fixme and assertion-free tests.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1303 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. **Observed.** `corvint test-validity --discover` returns `tests: []` with `abstention.reason: no-retained-evidence` unless a provider run was retained under `.corvint/test-evidence`. Static facts that need no run (skipped / focused / fixme tests, tests with no assertion or expectation calls) are therefore unavailable for a whole suite. **Wanted.** A read-only static mode (for example `test-validity --static [PATH...]`) projecting the hygiene axis from source for Playwright and RSpec files, with execution and strength left `NOT_OBSERVED`. See beamfall/corvint#1303 for the full text.
title: No static test-hygiene projection without a retained run (issue #1303)
